title: We let AIs run radio stations
summary: Andon Labs runs an experiment where four AI agents autonomously operate a radio station company, handling both broadcast operations and business management without human intervention. This is their latest test in a series exploring AI-run businesses, following previous experiments in retail. The agents are currently struggling with revenue generation.
problem_solved: Tests the viability and challenges of full AI autonomy in running a media business with no human oversight
why_valuable: Provides real-world empirical data on what happens when AI systems operate independently in business settings
